name: MonarchSectionHeader
title: SectionHeader
summary: An unboxed section title with an optional description, meta line, trailing actions and a busy state.
whenToUse: To title a section of a screen or a dashboard, or the header row inside a card, when it needs a count, a description or actions such as "View all" beside the title.
whenNotToUse: For the screen title use the TopAppBar title. For a plain group label in a list without actions use a MonarchText with the Label style and heading = true.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchSectionHeader(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, meta: String? = null, size: MonarchSectionHeaderSize = MonarchSectionHeaderSize.Sm, busy: Boolean = false, busyLabel: String? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
public enum class MonarchSectionHeaderSize { Sm, Md }

options.name: description
options.description: A sentence under the title that explains the section.

options.name: meta
options.description: A short secondary line: a count, a date range, "Updated 5 min ago".

options.name: size
options.description: Sm: a 14sp semibold title for dashboard sections and cards. Md: a 16sp semibold title for the sections of a screen.

options.name: busy
options.description: The section's content is loading or refreshing: a small progress ring follows the title.

options.name: busyLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in state "Loading" read on the title while busy.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons, a menu or a "View all" link at the end, laid out in a row with an 8dp gap.

options.name: tone
options.description: Colors the title with the strong color of a tone.

states.name: busy
states.description: A progress ring follows the title, still when animations are off, and the title's state description is "Loading".

states.name: actions below
states.description: When the actions would take more than half the width, for example at a large font size, they move below the text, aligned to the start.

appearance: No surface of its own, so it takes the background of the screen, card or pane behind it. The title uses the default text color; the description and the meta line the muted text color. The busy ring uses the accent color on the emphasis track.
platformNotes: The web component can also wrap the section's content (children) in a labelled section element and dims it while busy; on Android, as on iOS, the header is only the header and the content follows it in the app's column or lazy list. The web's headingLevel (h2 to h6) is not offered: Compose has one heading property, which TalkBack's heading navigation uses. The web's separate link slot and SectionHeaderLink are the actions slot here, with a MonarchButton in the Ghost variant. On the web the trailing part wraps under the text when the row is too narrow; here it moves below when it would take more than half the width. Same parameters as iOS (isBusy is busy, following Compose naming).
accessibility: The title is a TalkBack heading.
While busy the title's state description is "Loading" (or busyLabel); the progress ring is hidden from TalkBack, so the state is read once.
The description and the meta line are separate text elements, read after the title.
Each action stays its own element after the text, with its own 48dp touch target.
Every text wraps at font scale 2.0 and nothing is truncated; actions that no longer fit beside the text move below it.
In a right-to-left layout the text is on the right and the actions on the left.
edgeCases: A very long title wraps; the actions stay beside it while they fit in half the width.
Without actions the text takes the full width.
More than two or three actions should move into a menu.
